academyBilling.title: Subscription
academyBilling.desc: The plan that keeps your academy on the platform: the directory and your students' bookings.
academyBilling.noAccess: Only the academy owner can view and manage the subscription.
academyBilling.loadError: We couldn't load the subscription status.
academyBilling.bannerGrace: Your subscription is in grace period: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} left to settle the payment.
academyBilling.bannerBlocked: Academy blocked for unpaid subscription. Your academy is now read-only.
academyBilling.tierExceeded: Your academy has {active} active students and this plan allows up to {max}
academyBilling.trialDaysLeft: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} of trial left. After that you need a plan to keep operating.
academyBilling.pendingChange: Scheduled change: switches to {tier} ({cycle}) on renewal on {date}.
academyBilling.pendingChangeNoDate: Scheduled change: switches to {tier} ({cycle}) at the start of the next cycle.
academyBilling.grace: Grace period: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} left
academyBilling.graceHint: Flow retries the charge automatically; keep balance on the registered card.
academyBilling.blockedHint: Settle the payment to reactivate your academy, the directory and your students' bookings.
academyBilling.changeNow: Upgrading applies immediately: the new plan's full cycle is charged.
academyBilling.changeScheduled: The change applies on renewal on {date}. No charge now.
academyBilling.changeScheduledNoDate: The change applies at the start of the next cycle. No charge now.
academyBilling.changeRevert: Undoes the scheduled change: your plan stays on {tier} ({cycle}).
academyBilling.subscribeError: We couldn't start the subscription. Try again.
academyBilling.consent: Subscription: {amount} will be charged automatically every {period} until you cancel. We notify you before each charge.
academyBilling.cardRedirectTitle: Last step: your card on Flow
academyBilling.cardRedirectDesc: You're going to Flow's secure page to register the card for the recurring charge. When done, you come back to OmniDance and the subscription is active.
academyBilling.cardRedirectCta: Go to Flow to register the card
academyBilling.pendingCardHint: Your subscription is on hold. Complete the card registration to activate it.
academyBilling.cancelConfirm: Cancel the subscription? The academy keeps operating until the end of the paid cycle; then it gets blocked.
academyBilling.cancelOk: Subscription cancelled. It stays active until the end of the cycle.
